autoStartServerDesc: Automatically start mira-app-server on system login, even when Mira is not running
closeToTrayDesc: Hide to system tray when clicking the close button
openWebActionDesc: How to open web links from the detail panel
customCssDesc: Global custom styles, applied on top of the theme style's custom CSS, live preview
customCssGlobalPlaceholder: Paste any CSS here, applied instantly
fontSizeDesc: Adjust the global UI font size, applied instantly
uiZoomDesc: Scale the entire interface (icons, spacing included), applied instantly
autoStartEnabledToast: The service will start automatically on system login
multiLibraryViewsDesc: Keep a separate background page and local state for each library
openFilePreviewInTab: Open previews in a new tab
openFilePreviewInTabDesc: Open file previews in an app tab within the current window
defaultViewModeDesc: Default view for new tabs; "Use Last" follows the last view used in this library (stored in the library's local config)
defaultGroupingDesc: Grouping used for new tabs; "Use last applied" follows the last grouping applied in this library
defaultFilterDesc: Filter applied automatically to new tabs (stored in the library's local config)
pageSizeDesc: Maximum number of items shown per page in list/grid views (stored in the library's local config)
deleteConfirmDesc: Show a confirmation dialog when deleting selected items; can also be disabled via "Remember this choice" in the dialog (stored in the library's local config)
confirmAfterImportDesc: When enabled, importing a folder or dropping files via the floating ball opens the upload dialog for confirmation; when disabled, files are imported into the current library directly (stored in the library's local config)
showFoldersInTabDesc: Show subfolders of the current folder at the top of media tabs (stored in the library's local config)
autoStartFailed: Failed to set system login item
saveError: An error occurred while saving settings
